# SheetJS Community Edition

`xlsx.full.min.js` is the unmodified version 0.20.3 standalone build from https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js.

It is vendored so roster workbooks are read locally without contacting a CDN at runtime. License: Apache 2.0, reproduced in SHEETJS-LICENSE.txt.

Official browser installation documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/
